'''Lyndall Denise''' ('''Lyn''') '''English''' is an Australian scholar whose research concerns primary and secondary school [[mathematics education]], "focused mainly on analogical
reasoning and [[problem solving]] in early childhood, statistical reasoning as
data modelling, mathematical modelling of complex systems, and links
between mathematical and scientific development".{{r|merga}} She is a professor in the Faculty of Creative Industries, Education & [[Social justice|Social Justice]], and School of Teacher Education & Leadership, at [[Queensland University of Technology]],{{r|qut}} and founding editor-in-chief of the journal ''Mathematical Thinking and Learning''.{{r|qut|mtl}}

==Education and career==
English was a student at the [[Kelvin Grove Teachers College|Kelvin Grove College of Advanced Education]], from which she has bachelor's and master's degrees in education.{{r|qut}} She became a primary school teacher in Queensland from 1974 to 1978, and served as the mathematics curriculum coordinator for the open access unit in Brisbane from 1979 to 1985.{{r|cengage}}

She has a PhD from the [[University of Queensland]],{{r|qut}} for which she received the outstanding dissertation awards of the Australian Association for Research in Education and of the Association for Supervision and Curriculum Development in 1989.{{r|ss}}

She joined the Queensland University of Technology as a lecturer in 1982, and was promoted to [[senior lecturer]] in 1988, associate professor in 1992, and professor in 2000. She has been associate director of the Centre for Mathematics and Science Education since 1993.{{r|cengage}}

She founded ''Mathematical Thinking and Learning'' in 1997,{{r|qut}} and continues to serve as its editor-in-chief.{{r|mtl}}

==Recognition==
English was elected to the [[Academy of the Social Sciences in Australia]] in 2003.{{r|ss}}

The Mathematics Education Research Group of Australasia gave her their 1997 Beth Southwell Practical Implications Award,{{r|bspia}} and their 2012 Career Research Medal.{{r|merga}}

==Books==
English is the coauthor of:
*''Mathematics Education: Models and Processes'' (with Graeme S. Halford, Lawrence Erlbaum Associates, 1995){{r|memp}}

Her [[edited volume]]s include:
*''Mathematical Reasoning: Analogies, Metaphors, and Images'' (edited, Lawrence Erlbaum Associates, 1997){{r|ami}}
*''Handbook of International Research in Mathematics Education'' (edited, Lawrence Erlbaum Associates, 2002; 2nd ed., [[Routledge]], 2009; 3rd ed., with David Kirshner, 2015){{r|hir}}
*''Mathematical and Analogical Reasoning of Young Learners'' (edited, Lawrence Erlbaum Associates, 2004){{r|maryl}}
*''Theories of Mathematics Education: Seeking New Frontiers'' (edited with [[Bharath Sriraman]], Springer, 2009){{r|tme}}
*''Reconceptualizing Early Mathematics Learning'' (edited with Joanne T. Mulligan, Springer, 2013){{r|recon}}
*''Early Engineering Learning'' (edited with Tamara Moore, Springer, 2018)
*''Growing the Research Base for Mathematical Modeling with Young Learners'' (edited with Jennifer Suh and Megan Wickstrom, Springer, 2021){{r|grb}}
